newsitem.title: USA: Cronos names Moore Stephens head auditor.
newsitem.headline: Cronos names Moore Stephens head auditor.

text.p: Cronos Group said Wednesday it appointed the accounting firm Moore Stephens as head auditor for the company.
Cronos said it selected Moore Stephens primarily for its international representation and its close affiliation with the ocean carrier business for over 50 years.
Moore Stephens is replacing Arthur Andersen, said Stephen Brocato, Cronos vice president for corporate affairs.
Moore Stephens has began auditing the 1996 financials for Cronos and expects the audit to be completed by May 31, Cronos said.
Moore Stephens North America Inc, the 12th largest auditing firm in the U.S., is part of Moore Stephens International Limited, which has over 280 firms in 65 countries.
Cronos is a large lessor of intermodal marine containers, owning and managing a fleet of dry cargo, refrigerated and tank containers and other specialized intermodal equipment.
